notes: Adds missing schema/contract and rotation orchestration coverage to complete lifecycle.

stories.title: Token Schema and Storage Contract
stories.description: Define and implement the persistent schema for bearer tokens including token_hash, issued_at, expires_at, status (active/revoked/expired), rotation_parent_id, and audit metadata. Ensure compatibility with MongoDB patterns used in GPTReader and enforce hashing (no raw token storage).

stories.title: Token Rotation Service Logic
stories.description: Implement core rotation logic that issues a new token, links it to the prior token via rotation_parent_id, invalidates or sunsets the prior token, and preserves lineage for audit. Include safeguards against replay or reuse of rotated tokens.

stories.title: Token Expiration Enforcement Logic
stories.description: Implement backend logic to evaluate expires_at on every token validation, reject expired tokens, and optionally mark them as expired in storage for audit consistency.
